page_title: Evaligo: Benchmarks and RL Environments for LLM Agents

sources.entry: Evaligo - Visual no-code AI workflow builder for SEO, marketing, and sales teams. Drag-and-drop agentic AI workflows with 100+ templates, prompt testing across GPT/Claude/Gemini, and one-click deployment as APIs or embeddable apps. Free tier available.

summary.name: Evaligo
summary.one_liner: Evaligo builds benchmarks and Harbor-format RL environments for LLM agents, covering real bug-fixing, prompt-injection safety, and multi-step tool use.
keywords: rl training environment for coding agents
use_cases: Training an LLM agent with RL on private environments
Evaluating coding agents on real repository bug fixes
Testing agents for prompt injection and data exfiltration
Comparing public models on agent benchmarks
Benchmarking multi-step tool use across apps
summary.what_it_does: Evaligo offers benchmark families built from real work, each paired with an RL environment in Harbor format. The SWE-Race family asks agents to fix real bugs (race conditions, deadlocks, cancellation bugs) in pinned, sandboxed repositories, verified by the project's own hidden tests. Other families cover prompt-injection resistance, graded on utility under attack and attack success rate, and long-horizon multi-step tool use graded on state across apps. Stateful simulated tool mocks, which can be seeded with data and injections, support these environments. The page reports public-model leaderboard scores for SWE-Race v0.1 and says held-out private splits give the official score.
notable: SWE-Race bug-fixing benchmark on pinned real repositories with hidden tests
Harbor-format RL environments usable with any RL trainer
Stateful simulated tool mocks seeded with prompt injections
Public and private test splits with a separate training split
caveats: Public-tier testing is free only with your own model API key; the private split (official score) is run by Evaligo
Comparison table on the page is a layout with no measured results yet
More coding benchmark families are described as in preparation
